subject: PromptTools sandbox integration checklist & trace requirements
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Ezra Levin <ezra@prompttools.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PromptTools sandbox integration checklist & trace requirements

Hi Ezra —

Thanks again for the run-through last week. We’re keen to move PromptTools into a short integration pilot that exercises:
- LangChain and LlamaIndex SDK compatibility (Python + Node)
- Trace propagation (our tracing hooks + your SDK instrumentation)
- Streaming behavior and incremental token accounting
- Model variant fallback and quantization exchange (how you surface variants)

Quick asks from our side so we can spin up a Redwood staging job:
1) A sandbox service account for PromptTools with a small test workspace (API key or short-lived creds).
2) A sample trace payload schema you prefer (span names/tags) so we can align our tracer.
3) Any environment variables or startup flags your side needs for SDK shims.
4) Confirmation you can run the attached integration-checklist through your CI (we'll do the same).

I attached a one-page checklist to start (integration-checklist.xlsx). Can you confirm the sandbox credentials and we’ll schedule a 30-minute pairing session to run the first flow (LangChain -> Redwood hosted model -> trace captured)?

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
From: Ezra Levin <ezra@prompttools.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Rossi <nina@langbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PromptTools sandbox integration checklist & trace requirements

Priya —

Appreciate the clear list. We can support all of the items you listed. Quick notes: 
- Sandbox: we'll provision a short-lived API key and a test project (expires in 30 days). I'll send creds to the email you confirm.
- Trace schema: attaching a compact trace-schema.json with our recommended span names (prompt.request, prompt.tokenize, model.infer, model.decode, cache.hit). If you need protobufs or a different format, say the word.
- Env flags: PROMPTTOOLS_TRACE=1 and PROMPTTOOLS_SDK_MODE=staging are sufficient to enable our tracing layer and more verbose logs.
- CI: we can run the checklist; we'll also include a lightweight harness to validate trace propagation with LangChain calls.

One ask from our side: can Redwood expose a minimal streaming playback endpoint so we can validate partial outputs and streaming latencies? That helps our SDK tests for client-side buffering.

Attaching trace-schema.json. I'll follow up with sandbox creds in a separate secure message.

—Ezra
Ezra Levin
Head of Integrations, PromptTools Inc
ezra@prompttools.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: PromptTools sandbox integration checklist & trace requirements

Forwarding Ezra's reply — this looks straightforward. A couple of internal notes as we prep the staging job:

- Test matrix (suggested):
  * LangChain (py) single-turn + multi-turn streaming
  * LlamaIndex ingest -> query (verify cache behavior)
  * SDK call patterns: sync/generation/streaming/function-call
  * Failover: force model variant unavailable, expect fallback to compatible quantized variant

- Telemetry we want collected by the harness:
  * trace_id, span_id, parent_id, token_count, model_variant, duration_ms, cache_hit
  * per-request token billing (to verify matching cost accounting)

- Karthik: can your runtime team expose the streaming playback Ezra requested? If not, we can simulate with a small runner that buffers and sends chunked events.

I've dropped a draft SOW in our shared folder (sow-draft.docx) — it's intentionally light (pilot scope + success criteria).

Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ezra Levin <ezra@prompttools.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PromptTools sandbox integration checklist & trace requirements

Thanks all — putting operational constraints here so the pilot expectations are clear:

- Canary & capacity: we'll provision a small dedicated slot in Redwood Dedicated staging (2x A10G equivalent). Canary will be limited to 10 rps and 60s max seq length for the first pass.
- Streaming endpoint: I can expose a playback endpoint (https://staging-playback.redwood.internal/prompttools) that will stream chunked events; we'll auth with the sandbox key. It returns chunked \"data: { ... }\" frames identical to production.
- Metrics hooks: please instrument the SDK to emit the span tag "redwood.job_id" and include token_count as an attribute so our console can reconcile cost.
- Rollout plan: 1) smoke tests with LangChain harness, 2) trace validation (span mapping), 3) small internal beta (3 customers), 4) wider pilot.

I'll create a short HubSpot note and attach the canary config. HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/record/DEAL-7832

Karthik
Director, Runtime Integrations, Redwood Inference
